notes.title: Voice Acting Added!
notes.content:
Hello!

Hope you had a great summer and are enjoying fall!

We're pleased to announce that key scenes in Proven: A Math RPG now have voice acting to further enrich your experience. These scenes include the intro, the ending and when you meet new characters to recruit.

We hope you'll enjoy these new additions!

notes.title: Difficulty Adjustments Added!
notes.content:
Hello!

When creating Proven: A Math RPG, significant focus and attention was given to the difficulty curve to ensure that the game was neither too easy or too hard.  

In the interest of maximizing customization, we have added multiple difficulty options to cater to players that would like to make things easier or want an increased  challenge.  

These difficulty adjustments can be accessed by entering the large house to the right upon entering town.

We hope you enjoy the new update as well as the previous enhancements given in previous updates.

Have a great day!

notes.title: New Content Added to Computer Lab
notes.content:
Hi!

Hope you're having a great spring and are continuing to enjoy the game (along with the previous update that provides more treasure to discover).

As you may know, the Computer Lab (located in town) is a great place to earn bonus rewards by solving math problems by accessing the different terminals.  

Thanks to The J-Pop Exchange (my radio show) you can now hear an exclusive interview with Miki Igarashi.  Ms. Igarashi is known in Japan for her work in science and for encouraging women to enter STEM fields of study. She created her own YouTube channel that makes science come alive through fun experiments! 

Hope you enjoy this new content; I look forward to sharing with you more updates in the future!

Have a great day!
